thread:
Oncall Bot: PAGING: p99 latency spike detected for streaming endpoints (svc=redwood-gen-stream) at 21:03 UTC, infra auto-page threshold breached :rotating_light:
Sam K (sre): saw it, joining. p95 also drifting up. do we have customer-facing errors?
CS-Alert Bot: Customer report: several API timeouts from acme-marketing at ~21:05 UTC, ticket created #3248.
Maya R (infra): grafana shows sudden increase in tail from 180ms -> 1.4s for p99 on node pool gpu-pool-east-2, concurrent long-context requests spiking.
Priya (eng): this started right after the int8 calibration profile rollout at 20:50 UTC to the staged fleet (canary->prod sweep).
Julio (prod): rolling rollback of the int8 profile in flight? we need customer impact triage first.
Sam K (sre): capturing quick metrics:
```
series: streaming.latency.p99: 180ms -> 1.4s
streaming.stalls.rate: 0.1% -> 4.6%
cpu/gpu utilization: unchanged on control plane
KV-cache hit rate: slight drop
```
Maya R (infra): logs show frequent dequantization retries and occasional kv-cache miss storms for long prompt prefixes. appears correlated with int8 weight quantization path.
Priya (eng): confirmed; calibration introduced new fusion kernels that change memory layout for KV cache. Edge-case for long histories causing extra copies + stalls.
Sam K (sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback calib profile, 2) route long-context requests to fp16 variant, 3) enable bypass-dequant flag to use fallback runtime. which is lowest risk?
Julio (prod): route + bypass sounds safest to avoid full rollback while we validate. can we do a split by route?
Maya R (infra): routing rule ready. I can flip traffic for streaming endpoints with history-length>2048 to fp16 model variant and enable bypass-dequant on those nodes. ETA 5m.
Priya (eng): also add a temporary KV-cache warmup for affected pods to reduce misses. I'll push config change.
Sam K (sre): do it. keep canary at 10% first. watch p99.
Maya R (infra): flipping rule now to 10% -> 50% -> 100% for affected requests. monitoring.
Oncall Bot: action log: routing-change started by Maya R at 21:12 UTC.
Sam K (sre): after 15m looks like p99 dropped from 1.4s -> 320ms on routed traffic. overall p99 still ~420ms because not all traffic migrated yet.
Julio (prod): reach out to acme-marketing with update: temporary routing mitigation applied, investigating root cause, will update in 30m.
CS-Alert Bot: Notified customer (acme-marketing) with status: mitigation in place.
Priya (eng): digging into calibration job: one quant step used legacy percentile estimation for activation clipping; for longer sequences that leads to underflow and extra dequant attempts. I can patch the clip estimator and re-run calib but need time.
Sam K (sre): plan: keep routing mitigation + bypass active, patch calibration, run targeted A/B on small fleet, then re-roll. rollback avoided for now.
Maya R (infra): continuing autoscale cushion; temporarily increased burst capacity on dedicated pools to keep queuing low. No memory pressure observed.
Priya (eng): patch ready, testing in staging with long-context prompt set. results look good: stalls eliminated in staging.
Sam K (sre): schedule controlled canary: patch -> small canary -> monitor p99/p95/stream-stalls for 30m -> ramp.
Oncall Bot: escalation note: if p99 > 700ms for 10m then page SRE lead.
Julio (prod): prepping customer-facing postmortem stub. include timeline, customer impact, mitigation, next steps.
Maya R (infra): routing now at 100% for long-context; p99 back to baseline ~190ms. KV-cache hit rate recovering.
CS-Alert Bot: Customer updated: mitigation resolved majority of errors, will follow up when rollback/re-release complete.
Priya (eng): starting controlled roll of patched calibration to 5% -> monitoring.
Sam K (sre): observed no regressions at 5% for 20m. increasing to 25%.
Julio (prod): new ticket for post-incident QA + add long-context prompts to continuous calibration test harness. owner: Priya.
Priya (eng): noted. I'll add gating checks and a synthetic long-context suite.
Sam K (sre): handing off to night oncall: Maya you take next 6h watch for any tail regressions.
Maya R (infra): taking handoff. leaving routing mitigation active for 1h, will revert if stable.
Oncall Bot: Handoff recorded: Sam K -> Maya R at 22:05 UTC.
Sam K (sre): final note: root cause likely calibration percentile estimator + kernel change causing KV-cache miss amplification on long sequences. mitigation: routing fallback + bypass-dequant + patched calibration. follow-up items assigned.
Julio (prod): thanks everyone. I'll draft the brief and coordinate with CS for customer timeline.
Maya R (infra): monitoring pocket looks clean at the moment. closing paging for now, will reopen if any spike.
CS-Alert Bot: Ticket #3248 updated: mitigation applied, monitoring.
Sam K (sre): archived runbook update: add "calibration long-context regression" checklist.
Priya (eng): will add experiment logs and calibration parameters to the release notes.
Oncall Bot: THREAD CLOSED (for now) at 22:18 UTC.
